propers.name: Introit
propers.text:
Salve, sancta parens, enixa puerpera Regem: qui caelum terramque regit in
saecula saeculorum, alleluia, alleluia. Eructavit cor meum verbum bonum:
dico ego opera mea Regi. V. Gloria Patri.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text:
Hail, holy Mother, who have given birth to the King, who rules heaven and earth for ever and ever, alleluia, alleluia. My heart has poured out a good word: I recount my works to the King.
V. Glory to the Father.

The Mame is a French printing that uses j for consonantal i throughout its body text, so its j-forms here are systematic house orthography, not a local variant. On this point the Mame AGREES WITH THE 1862 PUSTET AGAINST THE 1962, so the human review's observation stands on two independent public-domain witnesses, and no public-domain page yet seen authorises the 1962's i-spelling of this word as an exact string..
